name: ticket-brew
description: Create, configure, publish and track Ticket Brew events from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Ticket Brew is a South African event ticketing platform for event organisers. Connect your Ticket Brew account to create and manage branded or personal organiser profiles, create event drafts, set the venue location, configure ticket tiers, add-ons and checkout questions, choose a page theme, create door scanner and promoter links, check publish readiness, get a link to publish events on the website, and track ticket sales and revenue. The plugin only accesses organizer profiles your connected account is a member of, and only with the permissions you approve.
defaultPrompt: Create a draft event for a comedy night in Cape Town next Friday.
How are ticket sales going for my upcoming events?
Add a R150 General Admission ticket to my latest event.

positive.prompt: Set up a Ticket Brew organiser profile called Cape Town Jazz with the subdomain ct-jazz.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks that the ct-jazz subdomain is available and creates the branded organiser profile.

positive.prompt: Show my upcoming events and drafts on Ticket Brew.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected organizer's events with their status and dates.

positive.prompt: Create a draft event called Summer Jam on 14 December 2026 at 18:00 in Cape Town.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unpublished draft event and returns its details and editor link.

positive.prompt: Add a General Admission ticket for R150 to Summer Jam.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a R150 (15000 cents) General Admission ticket type to the event.

positive.prompt: Set the Summer Jam venue to Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the venue and saves its address and map coordinates on the event.

positive.prompt: Is Summer Jam ready to publish? What's missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the publish checklist and explains any outstanding items.

negative.prompt: Show me the ticket sales for an organizer account I'm not a member of.
What is the capital city of France?
Buy me two tickets to a concert in Johannesburg.

review.commerce_description: The plugin manages organizer event listings and reports sales. It does not sell or purchase tickets inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Allows creating and managing branded organiser profiles and quick-start personal profiles directly from ChatGPT, removing profile logos/banners, managing ticket sales phases, and deleting unused ticket tiers.
